title: PDEA agents seize P1.7-M shabu, arrest suspect in Cotabato City
summary: COTABATO CITY, BARMM, Philippines — Authorities seized about P1.7 million worth of suspected shabu and arrested a suspected drug peddler during a joint buy-bust operation in Poblacion 5 here on…

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY, BARMM, Philippines — Authorities seized about P1.7 million worth of suspected shabu and arrested a suspected drug peddler during a joint buy-bust operation in Poblacion 5 here on Tuesday, Sept. 29. The operation was led by the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency–Maguindanao del Norte Provincial Office (PDEA-MagNor), according to PDEA-BARMM Regional Director George Paul
